correctness.rationale: Unique flags W=sum images and K=intersection kernels satisfy W subset K. Every representation bijects to a partial flag and ell maps V/K to W spanning W and with common kernel 0. Feasibility from a≤ell b and b≤ell a with constructions for a≥b and b≥a; flag-bundle open geometry gives d=(a+b)n-a²-b²+(ell−1)ab. Double subspace Möbius inversion gives exact H formula. Standalone brute-force checker compares every stratum over q=2,3,4 and n≤4, ell≤3; finite checks supplement an all-field argument.

value.rationale: Radical dimension and socle codimension are intrinsic natural module invariants. Their joint distribution (not just total representations), exact feasible region, and smooth geometrically integral rational strata give a uniform explanation for modules of arbitrary size over any radical-square-zero local algebra with arbitrary embedding dimension. The n=3 totals previously known are properly acknowledged rather than portrayed as the contribution.
